why: Dates and percentages as digits (tidy): "the 12th of March" -> "March 12", "by the fifteenth" -> "by the 15th", "eleven percent" -> "11%".
behaviour: the speaker says two or three dates, days of the month or percentages in words ("the twelfth of March", "March the nineteenth", "by the fifteenth", "September nineteen", "eleven percent")
rule: Write dates with a month name as "March 12" ("Thursday, March 12" with a weekday), a bare day of the month as "the 15th", and percentages as "11%".
